test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Table shows the annual income of 5 schools (in lakhs rupees). **SOURCE OF INCOME** **SCHOOLS ** **P** **Q** **R** **S**
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total income of school P is 140 + 280+ 110 + 102 + 160 = 792

Total income of school Q is 250 + 310+ 110 + 104 + 180 = 954

Total income of school R is 200 + 340+ 110 + 120 + 190 = 960

Total income of school S is 300 + 200+ 125 + 120 + 200 = 945

The percentage of income from donations out of the total income of school P is ,

⇒ 140 / 792 × 100 = 17.67 %

The percentage of income from donations out of the total income of school Q is ,

⇒ 250 / 954 × 100 = 26.20 %

The percentage of income from donations out of its total income of school R is ,

⇒ 200 / 960 × 100 = 20.80 %

The percentage of income from donations out of its total income of school S is ,

⇒ 300 / 945 × 100 = 31.74 %

**∴ The correct option is 3**
